verdict_source: Explicit internal reviewer response from /root/local_repair; not a zero-context external audit
normalization_note: Reviewer supplied the partial verdict and quantitative support/limitations. Remaining context and confidence below were normalized locally by /root/review_archive; the expanded reviewer response had not arrived at packaging time.
what_results_support: Verified coverage repair reduced the Fixed3 objective on the frozen generator; the independent verifier checked 2583 plans and bounds. Learning has limited conditional advantages over random selection. Separate 18-validation-scene profiling supports faster Fixed3 engineering at equal cost.
what_results_dont_support: Learning does not show a stable advantage over detour under all budgets, a full-planning speed advantage, hard real-time behavior, global optimality, real-arm execution safety, or a new PPO result.
missing_evidence: All-seed test uncertainty, more independent layouts and densities, parameter-matched architecture and STOP ablations, stronger coverage-routing solvers, true arm feasibility and hardware checks.
suggested_claim_revision: Present a verified Fixed3-based coverage-repair planner with optional gain-supervised window selection; describe quality/time tradeoffs and limited evidence for independent learning benefit.
next_experiments_needed: Only in a new separately frozen experiment round: broader intermediate-state training and unseen evaluation, all-seed fixed-budget tests, stronger optimization references, and real reachability integration. Do not tune on the current revealed test set.
confidence_source: Local normalization reflecting finite synthetic samples and one selected checkpoint
paper_verdict_status: provisional — no paper claim audit available
routing_action: Narrow current claim; retain default Fixed3 and optional learned mode; supplement only in future independent experiment rounds
